description: Source code for the LSM303DLHC magnetometer sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, including initialization, data fetching, and channel reading functions.

methods.name: lsm303dlhc_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches magnetometer data from the sensor via I2C and updates driver data.

methods.name: lsm303dlhc_convert_xy
methods.description: Converts raw magnetometer XY axis data to sensor_value format.

methods.name: lsm303dlhc_convert_z
methods.description: Converts raw magnetometer Z axis data to sensor_value format.

methods.name: lsm303dlhc_channel_get
methods.description: Retrieves specific magnetometer channel data in sensor_value format.

methods.name: lsm303dlhc_magn_init
methods.description: Initializes the magnetometer sensor, configuring I2C registers.
